findings: BTZ_1.tex:1376 « By construction, M1 ∧ M2 is maximal » is not by construction: the union is over globally hyperbolic domains (l.1352) while common sub-BTZ-extensions are not required globally hyperbolic (l.1306-1313), so maximality needs the maximal extension domain to be globally hyperbolic. That holds, but its proof is the chart step plus first-exit argument of the paper's own btzprop:ppcm third bullet (l.1497-1504), i.e. it is a forward dependency on § 5.2. Now proved: GX.Pgcd.globallyHyperbolicOn_dom, hence ghDom = dom.
M_0 globally hyperbolic (l.1343) is not needed for btzprop:pgcd's conclusions in the E_0 setting (GX.PpcmHausdorff.btz_pgcd_gh_of_gh).
